name: Medicine Ball Rotational Slam
steps: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder width holding a slam ball at one hip with knees soft.
Pivot on your back foot and arc the ball high up and over your head in a wide rainbow path.
Rotate sharply toward the opposite side, crunching your trunk and driving the ball forcefully into the floor outside your opposite foot.
Scoop the ball cleanly back up and arc it immediately overhead to slam onto the other side, alternating smoothly.
tips: Pivot your trailing foot cleanly with each arc so your knees stay aligned with your hips.
Use a non-bouncing slam ball or stay alert for rebound on every powerful slam.
